title: In Splunk App for Stream versions below 8.1.7, an unauthenticated user who can reach the Splunk App for Stream…
description: Splunk App for Stream versions below 8.1.7 contain an XML External Entity (XXE) vulnerability in the vocabulary upload REST API endpoint accessible on the management port 8089. This flaw allows an unauthenticated attacker who can reach the API to upload a crafted XML vocabulary file that can read local files accessible to the Splunk process or send outbound requests. The vulnerability arises because the XML parser does not enforce an application-level policy to block external entity resolution.
